subject: english
question:
**Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.**

Obedient
solution:
The correct answer is: **Disobedient**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Obedient** means obeying or willing to obey.

 
 
• *Example - As a child, he was always **obedient **to his parents.*
 
 
 
• Marked option Disobedient means refusing or failing to obey.
 
 
• *Example - The parents punished their **disobedient **child.*
 
 
 
• It is clear that 'Obedient' and 'Disobedient' are opposite in meaning.
 
• Therefore the correct answer is option 2.​

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Voluntary **means to do or work without payment.
 
• **Flexible **means that can be changed easily.
 
• **Willing **means being happy to do something, or having no reason for not doing something.
